requirements.HIT01: Accept near misses outside button artwork/saved rectangles in nearby empty space.
requirements.HIT02: Protect neighbouring button faces and assign each shared-margin point to one nearest original face.
requirements.HIT03: Full-strength digital target presses and immediate steering reversal across the shared margin, retaining independent finger ownership.
requirements.HIT04: Preserve safe/HUD bounds, artwork, layout persistence, analog behavior and canonical DriveFrame/physics.

implementation.hit_selection: Original target rectangles have priority. Otherwise select the eligible padded target with the shortest squared distance to its original rectangle, resolving ties in existing action order. Candidate bounding rectangles may overlap; resolved input is one action.
implementation.cache: Retain five original rectangles and five padded candidate rectangles until layout/safe-area fingerprint changes.
implementation.digital_pedals: Full strength throughout the enlarged target. Existing short downward release buffer fades only outside it. Crossing another action releases the owned pedal without transferring it.
implementation.steering: A four-unit slide across the left/right shared-margin divider selects opposite full input in the same event.
implementation.legacy_layout: Existing no-saved-layout expanded target geometry remains; neighbour ownership protection applies.
